identity: The same original fictional East Asian Chinese woman as the attached CC-036-face-only.png, now named Shen Xiuying, 71 years old, from Suzhou, Jiangsu, China, 150 cm tall. Preserve her finely wrinkled face, small mole on the same cheek, white hair in a precise tidy bun, warm alert dark-brown eyes. stylization: Character stylization (A2, pushed): 3D feature-animation adult with realistic adult body proportions at this actor's height; normal head size, natural neck, shoulders, torso, pelvis and leg lengths. Her Chinese identity must read through her facial structure rather than clothing. Preserve distinctive ordinary-person facial features, gently exaggerated from life, not a generic beauty-standard face. Slightly enlarged expressive eyes without enlarging the whole head; simplified cheek, nose and lip planes; smooth stylized skin shading with soft subsurface scattering and no pores; clean grouped hair clumps. Clothing uses realistic clean unbranded materials. Unmistakably CG at first glance, never photoreal.

tagline.en: Thirty years driving trucks. Now she wears qipao to the market.
tagline.zh: 开了三十年大货车，如今穿旗袍逛菜场。

introduction.en: Petite, with immaculate silver hair in a bun, Shen Xiuying looks particular about every detail. She spent thirty years driving heavy trucks. Now retired, she wears qipao to the market every day.
introduction.zh: 白发盘得一丝不乱，小个子，看着就讲究。开了三十年大货车的退休司机，现在天天穿旗袍去菜场。

note.zh: 55 张图、6 段占位声音、4 条样片。

voices.transcript: 我叫沈秀英，苏州人，今年七十一。年轻时开了三十年大货车，天南地北都跑过。现在退休了，穿条干净旗袍去买菜，慢慢挑，也蛮好。

Hello, I'm Shen Xiuying. I'm seventy-one, from Suzhou. I drove heavy trucks for thirty years. Now I'm retired. I like to put on a clean qipao and walk to the market. No rush today. Let me choose the vegetables slowly.
这把青菜蛮新鲜的，你看，叶子还挺着呢。帮我称一点就好，吃完再来买。篮子我自己拎得动，开了那么多年大车，这点东西算什么。
哎，这个颜色好看，衬得人精神。今天太阳又好，穿着出去走走。菜要买，花也看一眼，退休了嘛，总该让自己高兴一点。
急什么呀，车都还没停稳，你往前挤做啥？先退回来，站稳了再走。我开了三十年车，这种险可不能图省事，听见没有？
有时候起得早，还以为今天要出车呢。坐一会儿才想起来，早就退休啦。那些老路现在不知道什么样了，想想，心里还真有点舍不得。
